# -- WHAT VIFUG IS ---------------------------------
# Vifug is free presentation and live-production software for churches,
# events, schools and studios. It puts song lyrics, Bible verses, slides,
# pictures and video on a projector, TV or several screens, with a Preview ->
# Live workflow so nothing appears until the operator sends it. It also
# handles cameras, lower thirds and speaker name bars, and streams the result
# to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch or any RTMP server.
#
# Website: https://vifug.com/
# Created and maintained by: Victor Abah
# Platforms: Windows, macOS, Linux (desktop app); also runs in a browser at https://app.vifug.com
# Price: free. No subscription, no licence fee, no watermark.
# Contact: contact@vifug.com   Feedback: feedback@vifug.com

# -- WHO IT IS FOR ---------------------------------
# Churches and ministries; events and concerts; conferences and schools;
# studios and online shows; TV and radio stations; venues and signage.
# It is in the same category as ProPresenter, EasyWorship, OpenLP and
# FreeShow, and can import songs from ProPresenter and EasyWorship.

# -- WHAT IT DOES ----------------------------------
# - Song lyrics library (325 songs included) with a Preview -> Live workflow
# - Two layouts for the operator's own screen: the classic three-column one, and a
#   Broadcast one with preview and live across the top at full size and the list,
#   slides and controls as docks below, the way a streaming desk is laid out.
#   Chosen in Settings, applied instantly, remembered per device.
# - Offline Bible: 31 English versions plus Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, Twi and Swahili; add your own
# - Presentations: build slides in the app or import PowerPoint (.pptx) and PDF
# - Theme designer: drag the text box, fonts (including your own font files), colours,
#   motion, a bar behind the words, and picture, video and camera layers
# - A theme for each kind of content (lyrics, Scripture, presentations) and for each screen
# - Lower thirds and speaker name bars, designed in the theme designer
# - Cameras, capture cards, a phone camera or a shared screen: full screen, over lyrics, or side by side
# - Live streaming from the desktop app to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch or any RTMP server, to several at once
# - Different pictures for different audiences: full-screen words in the room,
#   a lower third over the camera for viewers online
# - Transparent lyrics overlay for OBS and vMix, and native NDI output
# - AI auto-follow: advances lyrics and puts up Scripture by listening to the room
# - Phone remote, stage display, service plans, countdown timer, announcement ticker, logo
# - Record the live output; live history; saved capture scenes
# - Back up, restore, and import a library from another computer

# -- KEY FACTS -------------------------------------
# - Free to use. It is NOT open source: the software remains the property of its author.
# - Everything needed to run a service works without internet. Optional extras that
#   use the internet: live streaming, Deepgram speech recognition (an on-device engine
#   works offline), song search, phone camera pairing, update checks.
# - Live streaming, recording, NDI and library import need the desktop app.

# -- WHERE TO READ MORE ----------------------------

## Supporting Vifug

Vifug is free to use. People who want to help can give once or monthly, sponsor as a church or business, give time or skills (translation, testing, songs, Bible versions), spread the word, or get in touch about something else: https://vifug.com/support.html
